title: Rooftop — scattered overwriting
source_passage: The city sprawled beneath them like an infinite circuit board of longing and regret. Kell checked the rope. 'We should go,' I said, though it was Kell who had spoken. The night was the profound and total absence of everything that mattered. 'We should go,' Kell said. Below, a siren rose and fell.
user_context: This is overcooked in places and the point of view slips. Clean it.
